posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Joe Starkey calls out the Steelers Defense: “Right now, the highest-paid defense in football is middle of the pack statistically. We hear a lot about how great they are and how they fit the Steelers tradition, but too often what we actually see on the field doesn't match the reputation.This goes back years. The last Steelers defense that truly felt like an all-time Steelers defense was that 2010 group. Since then, there have been good moments, but not sustained greatness. Personnel changed, stars retired, and it has never really felt the same.If I were a Steelers fan, that's the part that would drive me crazy. It's been a long time since this defense delivered the kind of dominant playoff performances people still talk about. Yet the reputation remains.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Joe Starkey on 93.7 The Fan says it’s time for the Steelers Defense to Step Up: “Back in the Dick LeBeau era, or especially during the Steel Curtain days, this is the kind of game you wouldn't just pencil in as a win, you'd write it in permanent marker. That's what this should be. This defense, with all the money invested in it and all the star power it has, needs to dominate a rookie undrafted quarterback making his third career start. That's simply what has to happen. Ten points should be enough to win this game. Fourteen or seventeen should feel like a luxury. You're facing a good Tampa Bay defense. We saw that against Dallas. They're strong against the run. But if you're supposed to be an elite defense, the kind of defense you're paying for every year, then this is where you prove it.” #Steelers #NFL

Eagles RB Will Shipley suffered a partial tear to his plantar fascia in Sunday’s loss to the Jaguars, per sources.

Shipley started in the absence of Saquon Barkley and Tank Bigsby. Now another RB injury, though there’s optimism Barkley will be back soon.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Panthers Pro Bowl CB Jaycee Horn is out indefinitely after suffering a quad injury in Sunday’s loss to the Browns, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Horn is seeking a second opinion. But he’s likely to land on injured reserve and miss significant time.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield underwent tests that showed no fracture and no tendon or ligament damage in his right thumb, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports. 

Mayfield will need to regain strength after Sunday’s dislocation and likely will miss some time. But good news overall.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
By trading J.J. McCarthy now, the Vikings save over $4.6M in cash and cap space and get an unconditional fifth-round pick in the next draft that, depending how the Giants finish, could end up being a top-150 selection.

Meanwhile, New York adds another former first-round pick QB.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Trade! The Vikings are sending QB J.J. McCarthy to the Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, New York adds another young QB, while Minnesota gains flexibility and McCarthy gets a fresh start.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The 49ers are signing veteran DT Naquan Jones off the Vikings practice squad, per source.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart is getting additional medical opinions on his injured knee that will determine whether to have surgery, which in turn will determine whether he can return this season or not. For now, he’s out indefinitely, as ESPN reported. Jameis Winston takes over as QB1.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow again, coach Dan Quinn confirmed, adding that an X-ray didn’t show a fracture.

More tests to come Monday, but Daniels will be out for some time: “We’ll rally around Marcus (Mariota).”

Leftwich interviewed for multiple NFL jobs this past cycle (Pats HC, Seahawks OC) but now makes the move to college.

irregularities.title: bluesky was not reachable on this run
irregularities.detail: Probe of https://public.api.bsky.app/xrpc/app.bsky.feed.searchPosts?q=nfl%20injury&limit=1&sort=latest returned status=403 (HTTP 403 Forbidden). The adapter was SKIPPED rather than retried, so this run has no posts from that platform. app.bsky.feed.searchPosts is HTTP 403 for this project (re-measured 2026-09-18 from the CI runner and from an independent client IP). Unauthenticated Bluesky search is therefore unavailable; discovery comes from Google News and from the verified handles this project follows directly (app.bsky.feed.getAuthorFeed, which does work).

irregularities.title: reddit was not reachable on this run
irregularities.detail: Probe of https://www.reddit.com/r/NFL_Discussion/about.json?raw_json=1 returned status=403 (HTTP 403 Blocked). The adapter was SKIPPED rather than retried, so this run has no posts from that platform. Reddit's public JSON endpoints have contested availability in 2026 (some reports say ~60 req/min unauthenticated, others say broadly blocked with 403 since May 2026), so an unreachable probe here is expected and is not treated as a pipeline failure.
